zipper.gui.screen.config.main.title: Zipper Settings
zipper.gui.screen.config.main.hide-force: Hides forced resource and data packs from the selection menu.
zipper.gui.screen.config.main.hide-built: Hides built-in resource and data packs from the selection menu.
zipper.gui.screen.config.main.warn-enabl: Enables/disables the warning screen when packs could not be downloaded from the internet. Don't disable this unless you're okay with users skipping pack downloads.
zipper.gui.screen.config.main.prompt-ena: Enables/disables the reload prompt that shows after successfully downloading packs from the internet. If disabled, the game will automatically reload.
zipper.gui.screen.config.main.disable-co: Enables/disables Minecraft's version compatibility warnings for loaded packs.
zipper.gui.screen.config.main.button-off: Moves the title screen button. Useful if it's overlapping with another mod's button.
zipper.gui.screen.config.dependencies.de: Are you sure you want to delete this pack?
zipper.gui.screen.config.dependencies.ed: The file name to load the pack from. This does not include the file extension.
